data.one_liner: A fully customizable draggable bottom sheet for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Sheet widget that can be placed inside any page or pushed as a modal SheetRoute to your navigator. It supports custom min/max extents, resizable content, and programmatic position control using a SheetController.
use_when: You need a draggable bottom sheet embedded inside a page or as a route.
You require fine-grained control over sheet extents, min/max bounds, and resizability.
You want to sync animations with the sheet's position via a SheetController.
avoid_when: You are using a Flutter version older than 3.19 (which is required by version 1.0.1).
strengths: Fully customizable draggable bottom sheet behavior and bounds.
Supports both inline page usage (via Sheet widget) and navigation routes (via SheetRoute and SheetPage).
Provides a SheetController for programmatic movement and animation synchronization.
weaknesses: Documentation is somewhat sparse with features marked as TBD.
data.setup_notes: Add the sheet package to your pubspec with flutter pub add sheet.
